resumen: Hanging from a bar, the body comes up until the chin clears it. It is the bodyweight vertical pull, and the most demanding of the group.
ejecucion: Hang from the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and arms straight.
Before pulling, pull the shoulders down: it takes your head away from your ears and puts the lats to work.
Pull by driving the elbows down and back, until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control until the arms are fully straight, without dropping.
